identity.title: The Formation Conditions of the Wide Binary Class 0 Protostars within BHR 71

paper_type_evidence.quote: The protostars were then further characterized with ALMA observations in the 1.3 mm continuum along with N$_2$D$^+$ ($J=3\rightarrow2$), $^{12}$CO, $^{13}$CO, and C$^{18}$O ($J=2\rightarrow1$) molecular lines.

evidence.quote: two Class 0 protostars (cite: andre1993) separated by $\sim$16$''$ (3200 AU; 200 pc distance)

question.value: What physical process (rotational vs turbulent fragmentation) formed the wide Class 0 binary IRS1/IRS2 in BHR71?

evidence.quote: With this dataset, we aim to determine what physical process(es) lead to the formation of at least two protostars in this system.
BHR71 was observed by the ALMA 12m array, the ALMA Compact Array (ACA), and the Total Power Array (TPA) under the project 2013.1.00518.S.
The observations were conducted in band 6, with a central tuning frequency of 225 GHz.

findings_qualitative.value: C18O rotation on <1000 AU scales is in opposite directions around IRS1 and IRS2, with same systemic velocity

evidence.quote: the C$^{18}$O kinematics reveal that the rotation on scales $<$1000 AU around IRS1 and IRS2 are in *opposite* directions.

claims.hypothesis: Was the binary formed by rotational fragmentation?
claims.result: beta_rot<=0.006; opposite rotation; no velocity offset

evidence.quote: it is unlikely that their formation resulted from rotational fragmentation.

claims.experiment: Comparison with simulations and disordered velocity fields

evidence.quote: We instead conclude that the binary system most likely formed via turbulent fragmentation of the core.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Thermal Jeans fragmentation not clearly favored (Jeans length ~8400 AU)

evidence.quote: Thus, thermal Jeans fragmentation is not clearly a favored mechanism on its own to form the binary system

limitations_admitted.value: Outflow influence and line-of-sight geometry make interpretation uncertain; higher resolution/sensitivity needed

evidence.quote: A factor of 2-4 increases in both sensitivity and resolution would solidify this result.

referee_caveats_inferred: Rotation directions from C18O at ~1.5 arcsec resolution with short integration
Single-component hyperfine fits despite two components
beta_rot is an upper limit extrapolated assuming angular momentum conservation
